pairs: Præcepit autem Moyses et seniores Israël populo,
Then Moses and the elders of Israel instructed the people,
Custodite omne mandatum quod præcipio vobis hodie.
“Keep each commandment that I instruct to you this day.
And when you have crossed over the Jordan,
quam Dominus Deus tuus dabit tibi,
into the land which the Lord your God will give to you,
and you shall coat them with plaster,
ut possis in eis scribere omnia verba legis hujus,
so that you may be able to write upon them all the words of this law,
Jordane transmisso: ut introëas terram, quam Dominus Deus tuus dabit tibi,
when you have crossed the Jordan so as to enter into the land which the Lord your God will give to you,
a land flowing with milk and honey,
just as he swore to your fathers.
Therefore, when you have crossed over the Jordan,
quos ego hodie præcipio vobis in monte Hebal,
just as I instruct you to do this day, on Mount Ebal.
And you shall coat them with plaster,
et ædificabis ibi altare Domino Deo tuo de lapidibus, quos ferrum non tetigit,
and you shall build, in that place, an altar to the Lord your God out of stones which have not been touched by iron,
et de saxis informibus et impolitis:
out of stones which have not been hewn or polished.
et offeres super eo holocausta Domino Deo tuo,
And you shall offer holocausts on it to the Lord your God.
And you shall immolate peace victims.
And you shall eat and feast in that place,
et epulaberis coram Domino Deo tuo.
in the sight of the Lord your God.
Et scribes super lapides omnia verba legis hujus plane
And you shall write upon the stones all the words of this law,
Dixeruntque Moyses et sacerdotes Levitici generis ad omnem Israëlem: Attende,
And Moses and the priests of Levitical stock said to all of Israel: “Attend and listen,
Israël: hodie factus es populus Domini Dei tui:
Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
You shall listen to his voice,
and you shall do the commandments and justices,
which I am entrusting to you.”
Præcepitque Moyses populo in die illo,
And Moses instructed the people in that day,
Hi stabunt ad benedicendum populo super montem Garizim,
“These shall stand upon Mount Gerizim, as a blessing to the people,
when you will have crossed the Jordan:
Et e regione isti stabunt ad maledicendum in monte Hebal:
And in the opposite region, there shall stand upon Mount Ebal, as a curse:
And the Levites shall pronounce and declare to all the men of Israel,
dicentque ad omnes viros Israël excelsa voce:
Maledictus homo qui facit sculptile et conflatile,
Cursed be the man who makes a graven
a work of the hands of its maker,
and who puts it in a secret place.
And all the people shall respond by saying:
Maledictus qui non honorat patrem suum,
Cursed be he who does not honor his father
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui transfert terminos proximi sui:
Cursed be he who removes his neighbor’s landmarks.
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui errare facit cæcum in itinere:
Cursed be he who causes the blind to go astray on a journey.
And all the people shall say:
Cursed be he who subverts the judgment of the new arrival,
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui dormit cum uxore patris sui,
Cursed be he who lies with his father’s wife,
and so exposes the covering of his bed.
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui dormit cum omni jumento:
Cursed be he who lies with any beast.
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui dormit cum sorore sua,
Cursed be he who lies with his sister,
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui dormit cum socru sua:
Cursed be he who lies with his mother-in-law.
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui clam percusserit proximum suum:
Cursed be he who secretly strikes down his neighbor.
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui accipit munera, ut percutiat animam sanguinis innocentis:
Cursed be he who accepts gifts in order to strike down the life of innocent blood.
And all the people shall say:
Maledictus qui non permanet in sermonibus legis hujus,
Cursed be he who does not remain in the words of this law,
and does not carry them out in deed.
